metadata.title: 게임수학 Part 2 · 평면과 삼각형 ② 삼각형 안의 주소
metadata.description:
앞 편에서 표면까지의 거리와 가장 가까운 점을 찾았습니다. 하지만 평면 위에 있다는 것만으로 유한한 발판 안인지 알 수는 없습니다. 같은 삼각형과 점을 유지하면서 넓이, 세 꼭짓점의 가중합, 주어진 점의 가중치 계산으로 이어갑니다. 화면에서 같은 위치로 보이는 점도 실제 평면 위인지 따로 확인합니다. 마지막에는 찾은 위치에 같은 가중치를 적용해 색 같은 표면 값을 계산합니다. 평면과 삼각형 두 편 중 두 번째 강의입니다.

02:38 같은 넓이를 세 방법으로 구하기
03:27 두 점의 보간에서 세 꼭짓점의 비율로
03:52 세 숫자로 삼각형 위치 표현하기
04:35 삼각형의 기준을 함께 옮기기

06:43 넓이 비율에서 가중치 구하기

08:15 그림자의 주소와 물체의 주소는 다릅니다
08:39 투영은 평면 위 검사까지 해주지 않습니다
09:26 떠 있는 물체와 바닥의 투영 위치를 구분합니다

10:44 위치를 찾았으니 그 자리의 값도 구합니다

11:58 같은 위치의 표면 값을 따로 생각합니다

englishMetadata.title: Game Math Part 2 · Planes and Triangles 2: An Address Within a Triangle
englishMetadata.description:
The first lecture found the distance to a surface and its closest point. Being on an infinite plane still does not establish that a point lies inside a finite platform. We retain the same triangle and point while moving from area to weighted vertex sums and then reading weights from the given point. Matching projected screen positions also requires a separate coplanarity check. Finally, the same weights transfer surface values such as color at that position. This is the second of two lectures on planes and triangles.

Game Math PART2 course materials
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/1ea0b1ff-a61e-803f-bd54-cac4f028f6b3

YamYamCoding website
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/

YamYamWiki course notes
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/0d2adf45-5d1a-43be-a37c-61c94b1ae2c8

40% actual gameplay and60% explanation, narrated without background music.

Chapters
00:00 Find an address inside a finite triangle
00:22 Connect edge lengths and angles
01:03 Locate a point between three references
01:48 Why does area help determine a point’s location?
02:07 Being on a plane does not establish passage membership
02:38 Calculate the same area in three ways
03:27 From two-point interpolation to three vertex weights
03:52 Describe a triangle position with three numbers
04:35 Move the triangle’s reference together
05:32 Calculate positions inside and outside
06:18 Read the address back from the point we created
06:43 Recover weights from area ratios
07:27 Observe surfaces at different heights
08:15 A projected address differs from the actual point
08:39 Projection does not establish coplanarity
09:26 Separate an airborne object from its floor projection
09:55 Track three observed corners together
10:44 Use the address to retrieve a surface value
11:12 Interpolate color with the same weights
11:58 Separate surface position from its stored value
12:21 Observe surface location and color together
13:18 Check distance, plane membership and weights together
14:11 Membership thanks and programming coaching

🎮 Build games with real programming skills.

YamYamCoding is a Korean game-programming channel covering DirectX, Unity, Unreal Engine and computer graphics.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Learn to design and implement real projects with guided feedback.
